title: Work & School
description: Talk about what you do all day.

questions.sentence: Tame shu kaam karo cho?
options: Hu shikshak chu.
Hu Surat ma rahu chu.
Mane maru kaam game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu shikshak chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I am a teacher.

questions.sentence: Hu ek kampani ma kaam karu chu.
options: I work at a company.
I am looking for a job.
I own a small company.
questions.correctAnswer: I work at a company.

questions.sentence: Tame kya kaam karo cho?
options: Hu Ahmedabad ma kaam karu chu.
Hu roj kaam karu chu.
Hu aa kaam nathi karto.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu Ahmedabad ma kaam karu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I work in Ahmedabad.

questions.sentence: Maro bhai doctor che.
options: My brother is a doctor.
My brother is a student.
My father is a doctor.
questions.correctAnswer: My brother is a doctor.

questions.sentence: Tamari naukri kevi che?
options: Mari naukri saras che.
Mane naukri joie che.
Hu naukri nathi karto.
questions.correctAnswer: Mari naukri saras che.
questions.translatedSentence: My job is good.

questions.sentence: Mari behen college ma bhane che.
options: My sister studies at a college.
My sister teaches at a college.
My brother studies at a college.
questions.correctAnswer: My sister studies at a college.

questions.sentence: Tame office ma kaam karo cho?
options: Ha, hu office ma kaam karu chu.
Na, hu ghare thi kaam karu chu.
Ha, mane office game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, hu office ma kaam karu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I work in an office.

questions.sentence: Mane maru kaam bahu game che.
options: I like my work very much.
I need work very badly.
I like my office very much.
questions.correctAnswer: I like my work very much.

questions.sentence: Tamaro mitra shu kaam kare che?
options: Te engineer che.
Te Vadodara ma rahe che.
Te aaje kaam par nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Te engineer che.
questions.translatedSentence: He is an engineer.

questions.sentence: Shikshak varg ma che?
options: Ha, teo atyare varg ma che.
Na, teo aaje shala ma nathi.
Ha, teo bahu saras shikshak che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, teo atyare varg ma che.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, he is in the classroom right now.

questions.sentence: Amara varg ma ghana vidyarthi che.
options: There are a lot of students in our class.
There are only a few students in our class.
There are a lot of teachers in our school.
questions.correctAnswer: There are a lot of students in our class.

questions.sentence: Taru pustak kya che?
options: Maru pustak bag ma che.
Mare navu pustak joie che.
Aa pustak maru nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Maru pustak bag ma che.
questions.translatedSentence: My book is in my bag.

questions.sentence: Kripa kari ne pustak kholo.
options: Please open the book.
Please close the book.
Please read the book aloud.
questions.correctAnswer: Please open the book.

questions.sentence: Tamne aa prashna samjay che?
options: Na, mane aa samjatu nathi.
Ha, mane badhu samjay che.
Ha, thodu thodu samjay che.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, mane aa samjatu nathi.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I do not understand this.

questions.sentence: Shikshak board par lakhe che.
options: The teacher is writing on the board.
The teacher is reading from the book.
The student is writing on the board.
questions.correctAnswer: The teacher is writing on the board.

questions.sentence: Shu hu ek prashna puchi shaku?
options: Ha, jarur puchho.
Na, atyare samay nathi.
Ha, pan pachi puchjo.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, jarur puchho.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, please do ask.

questions.sentence: Aa varg ma ame Gujarati bhaniye chie.
options: In this class we study Gujarati.
In this class we speak only English.
We teach Gujarati in this class.
questions.correctAnswer: In this class we study Gujarati.

questions.sentence: Tame aa prashna no javab lakhyo?
options: Ha, me javab lakhi didho.
Na, mane javab khabar nathi.
Ha, pan maro javab khoto che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, me javab lakhi didho.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have written the answer.

questions.sentence: Tamari desk kya che?
options: Mari desk bari pase che.
Mari desk par navu computer che.
Hu bija majla par besu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Mari desk bari pase che.
questions.translatedSentence: My desk is next to the window.

questions.sentence: Me tamne savare email mokalyo che.
options: I sent you an email in the morning.
I will send you an email in the morning.
I got your email in the morning.
questions.correctAnswer: I sent you an email in the morning.

questions.sentence: Meeting ketla vagye che?
options: Meeting agiyar vagye che.
Meeting kale che.
Meeting radd thai gai che.
questions.correctAnswer: Meeting agiyar vagye che.
questions.translatedSentence: The meeting is at eleven o'clock.

questions.sentence: Saheb atyare meeting ma che.
options: The boss is in a meeting right now.
The boss has already gone home.
The boss has a meeting tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: The boss is in a meeting right now.

questions.sentence: Tame report puro karyo?
options: Na, hu haju lakhu chu.
Ha, me kale j mokali didho.
Mane aa report vishe khabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, hu haju lakhu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I am still writing it.

questions.sentence: Mara computer ma kaik problem che.
options: There is some problem with my computer.
There is no problem with my computer.
There is some problem with my phone.
questions.correctAnswer: There is some problem with my computer.

questions.sentence: Shu tame mane aa file mokli shako?
options: Ha, hu atyare j mokalu chu.
Ha, pan mari pase te file nathi.
Na, tame saheb ne puchho.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, hu atyare j mokalu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will send it right away.

questions.sentence: Ame roj savare meeting karie chie.
options: We have a meeting every morning.
We have a meeting every evening.
We had a meeting this morning.
questions.correctAnswer: We have a meeting every morning.

questions.sentence: Tamaro phone kem band hato?
options: Maaf karjo, hu meeting ma hato.
Maro phone kharab thai gayo che.
Hu tamne pachi phone karu chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Maaf karjo, hu meeting ma hato.
questions.translatedSentence: Sorry, I was in a meeting.

questions.sentence: Tame ghar kaam puru karyu?
options: Na, mare haju thodu baki che.
Ha, me kale rate j karyu hatu.
Mane ghar kaam vishe khabar nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, mare haju thodu baki che.
questions.translatedSentence: No, I still have a little left.

questions.sentence: Amari pariksha aavta athvadiye che.
options: Our exam is next week.
Our exam was last week.
Our exam is next month.
questions.correctAnswer: Our exam is next week.

questions.sentence: Tame pariksha mate taiyari kari?
options: Ha, me aakhu pustak vanchi lidhu.
Na, mane samay nathi malyo.
Hu aaje rate vanchvano chu.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, me aakhu pustak vanchi lidhu.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I have read the whole book.

questions.sentence: Aa vishay mane bahu mushkel lage che.
options: I find this subject very difficult.
This subject feels very easy to me.
I do not like this subject at all.
questions.correctAnswer: I find this subject very difficult.

questions.sentence: Tame roj ketlo abhyas karo cho?
options: Hu roj be kalak abhyas karu chu.
Hu fakt raviware abhyas karu chu.
Mane abhyas karvo game che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu roj be kalak abhyas karu chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I study for two hours every day.

questions.sentence: Mane pariksha ma sara gun malya.
options: I got good marks in the exam.
I did not do well in the exam.
I will get good marks in the exam.
questions.correctAnswer: I got good marks in the exam.

questions.sentence: Tane aa dakhlo samjay che?
options: Na, tu mane samjavish?
Ha, aa to bahu sahelu che.
Mane ganit ma bahu ras nathi.
questions.correctAnswer: Na, tu mane samjavish?
questions.translatedSentence: No, will you explain it to me?

questions.sentence: Jo hu roj vanchu to pariksha saral lagshe.
options: If I study every day the exam will feel easy.
If the exam is easy I will study every day.
I study every day because the exam is difficult.
questions.correctAnswer: If I study every day the exam will feel easy.

questions.sentence: Tu kale mari sathe abhyas karish?
options: Ha, hu tara ghare avish.
Na, kale mare kaam par javu che.
Ha, pan aapne library ma jaie.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, hu tara ghare avish.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, I will come to your place.

questions.sentence: Tamaru office ketla vagye shuru thay che?
options: Nav vagye shuru thay che.
Sanje pach vagye puru thay che.
Amare shanivare raja hoy che.
questions.correctAnswer: Nav vagye shuru thay che.
questions.translatedSentence: It starts at nine o'clock.

questions.sentence: Hu roj savare aath vagye ghar thi niklu chu.
options: I leave home at eight every morning.
I reach home at eight every morning.
I leave home at eight every evening.
questions.correctAnswer: I leave home at eight every morning.

questions.sentence: Tame aaje modu kem karyu?
options: Maaf karjo, hu traffic ma phasai gayo hato.
Mari bus roj modi aave che.
Hu vahela niklyo hato pan varsad hato.
questions.correctAnswer: Maaf karjo, hu traffic ma phasai gayo hato.
questions.translatedSentence: Sorry, I got stuck in traffic.

questions.sentence: Mare kale ek divas ni raja joie che.
options: I need one day of leave tomorrow.
I took one day of leave yesterday.
I need two days of leave tomorrow.
questions.correctAnswer: I need one day of leave tomorrow.

questions.sentence: Shu hu aaje vahela ghare jai shaku?
options: Ha, pan pahela kaam puru karo.
Na, aaje sanje meeting che.
Ha, saheb ne kahi ne jao.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, pan pahela kaam puru karo.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but finish your work first.

questions.sentence: Aavti kale shala bandh che kem ke raja che.
options: School is closed tomorrow because it is a holiday.
School is open tomorrow even though it is a holiday.
School was closed yesterday because of a holiday.
questions.correctAnswer: School is closed tomorrow because it is a holiday.

questions.sentence: Tame ketla vagye ghare pahoncho cho?
options: Hu sanje sat vagye pahonchi jau chu.
Hu roj bus ma ghare jau chu.
Aaje mane thodu modu thashe.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu sanje sat vagye pahonchi jau chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I reach home by seven in the evening.

questions.sentence: Mane maaf karjo, mane aaje thodu modu thayu.
options: I am sorry, I got a little late today.
Excuse me, do you have the time?
Do not worry, I am not late today.
questions.correctAnswer: I am sorry, I got a little late today.

questions.sentence: Kale tame office kem nahota aavya?
options: Mari tabiyat sari nahoti.
Me ek divas ni raja lidhi hati.
Hu bahar gam gayo hato.
questions.correctAnswer: Mari tabiyat sari nahoti.
questions.translatedSentence: I was not feeling well.

questions.sentence: Aavta varshe tamari shu yojana che?
options: Hu navi naukri sodhvano chu.
Hu aa j kampani ma rahish.
Mare vadhu abhyas karvo che.
questions.correctAnswer: Hu navi naukri sodhvano chu.
questions.translatedSentence: I am going to look for a new job.

questions.sentence: Mane aa varshe badhti mali che.
options: I got a promotion this year.
I am hoping for a promotion this year.
My salary went up this year.
questions.correctAnswer: I got a promotion this year.

questions.sentence: Tame naukri kem badalva mango cho?
options: Kem ke mare navu kaam shikhvu che.
Kem ke pagar bahu ochho che.
Mare ghar ni pase kaam joie che.
questions.correctAnswer: Kem ke mare navu kaam shikhvu che.
questions.translatedSentence: Because I want to learn new kinds of work.

questions.sentence: Jo hu vadhu mehnat karish to mane badhti malshe.
options: If I work harder I will get a promotion.
If I get a promotion I will work harder.
I work hard but I did not get a promotion.
questions.correctAnswer: If I work harder I will get a promotion.

questions.sentence: Tamaru lakshya shu che?
options: Mare ek divas potani kampani shuru karvi che.
Mare Gujarati saras rite bolvi che.
Mare aavta varshe Vadodara ma rahevu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Mare ek divas potani kampani shuru karvi che.
questions.translatedSentence: One day I want to start my own company.

questions.sentence: Mane maru kaam game che pan pagar ochho che.
options: I like my work but the salary is low.
I do not like my work but the salary is good.
I like my work and the salary is good too.
questions.correctAnswer: I like my work but the salary is low.

questions.sentence: Tame saheb sathe pagar vishe vaat kari?
options: Ha, pan teoe na padi.
Na, hu aavta mahine vaat karish.
Ha, teoe vichar karvanu kahyu che.
questions.correctAnswer: Ha, pan teoe na padi.
questions.translatedSentence: Yes, but they said no.

questions.sentence: Hu aa kampani ma pach varsh thi kaam karu chu.
options: I have been working at this company for five years.
I worked at this company five years ago.
I will work at this company for five years.
questions.correctAnswer: I have been working at this company for five years.

questions.sentence: Aavta varshe tame shu shikhva mango cho?
options: Mare Gujarati ane thodu computer kaam shikhvu che.
Mare aa varshe kai nathi shikhvu.
Hu aavta mahine ek navo course shuru karish.
questions.correctAnswer: Mare Gujarati ane thodu computer kaam shikhvu che.
questions.translatedSentence: I want to learn Gujarati and a little computer work.
